about_the_game:
Launch balls, click everything, and select upgrades to progress through increasingly challenging levels. Vibe out to hypnotic full-screen clicker gameplay - or pin it in a corner and idle your way to success. Push forever further by exchanging progress for game-changing modifiers that unlock new builds and ways to play.

Perfect for idle gamers, clicker clickers, big number enjoyers, bored Zoom meeting participants, fidget spinner aficionados, ADHD havers, Windows 95 screensaver nostalgists, second screen addicts, those in desperate need of a quick hit of dopamine, and all the people still waiting for the DVD logo to hit the corner of the TV.

  • Click all the things or idleize your playstyle

  • Resize, rotate, customize, and pin anywhere

  • Cutting edge graphics in 4K or 144p

  • Unlock upgrades, modifiers, cheats, and development bugs

  • Sandbox Mode for unhinged experimentation

  • Benchmark your computer with Dragon Mode

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Break bricks to earn stuff to buy things to break more bricks. Half idle brick breaker, half clicker fidget spinner. Fullscreen it or drag it in a corner.
